backup.production_rule: take a fresh encrypted set immediately before the window; the named set is 1,674,192 bytes with SHA256SUMS verified OK on 2026-09-08 and has no restore proof yet

forward_verification.name: job_heartbeat_objects_exist
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.job_heartbeats') is not null and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.record_job_heartbeat(text,text,text)','execute')

forward_verification.name: price_history_keeps_its_six_column_contract
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 6 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'price_history_by_item'

rollback.safe_until: always - neither change carries operational data. Heartbeat rows are observability only, and the view fix restores a contract that currently raises 42P17

steps.name: stop_heartbeat_writes
steps.action: revoke service_role EXECUTE on public.record_job_heartbeat; callers already tolerate a failed heartbeat by logging a warning and continuing

steps.name: retain_heartbeat_history
steps.action: keep public.job_heartbeats and its rows; they are the only record of scheduled-job liveness

steps.name: revert_the_view_only_if_it_regresses
steps.action: re-apply the previous price_history_by_item definition from the schema dump. The current production definition selects from itself and raises 42P17, so reverting restores a broken view - prefer a forward fix

feature_flags.name: scheduler_heartbeat_monitoring
feature_flags.required_state: off until the job-heartbeat monitor function is deployed and its alert routing is reviewed; writing heartbeats is safe on its own

compatibility.evidence: job_heartbeats adds one private table and two functions and nothing existing references them. The price-history change replaces a view whose live definition selects from itself and therefore always errors, so no working reader can regress. A static scan on 2026-09-08 found no destructive statement in either file. Left unverified until supabase/tests/database/job_heartbeats.sql and price_history_view.sql are actually run, which needs a working local Postgres.

stop_conditions: the production restore point is older than the window
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value

turnover-verifier v10 already calls record_job_heartbeat and currently logs a warning because the function does not exist. Applying this release makes those writes start landing, which is the intended effect and not a regression
